title: KPI Bellwether & Capacity Playground
content:
Purpose: A compact preflight sheet to act as the single source-of-truth for launch readiness signals (performance, cost, reliability) and the contingency actions to execute when bellwether KPIs deviate.

Scope: This is intended for short-term launch windows and high-risk releases where we need a lightweight but prescriptive runway and playbook. Targets cover hosted API, Dedicated, and fallbacks to quantized variants.

How to use:
- Populate the current baseline values in the 'current' column before turning on traffic.
- Monitor P0/P1 triggers during the first 72 hours; automated alerts should map to the actions column.
- After the window, capture outcomes in the Change log section.

METRICS TABLE (columns: Metric | Definition | Target | Current | P0 trigger | P1 trigger | Owner | Immediate action):
- p95 response latency (user-facing):  Target <= 450ms | Current: -- | P0 >= 900ms sustained 5min | P1 >= 600ms sustained 10min | Owner: SRE (Rahul) | P0: divert to warm standby region + enable fast-fallback model; P1: increase worker autoscale + enable prefix cache warmup
- tokens/sec (endpoint throughput): Target >= 12k tokens/s cluster | Current: -- | P0 drop >50% vs baseline 5min | P1 drop >25% 10min | Owner: Infra (Devon) | P0: activate burst reserved capacity; P1: enable batching profile B2
- error rate (5xx + model-internal): Target < 0.3% | Current: -- | P0 > 2.0% 3min | P1 > 1.0% 10min | Owner: Product Ops (Aisha) | P0: rollback rollout to previous model version; P1: restrict traffic to beta group + escalate to model triage
- token cost per 1k tokens (USD): Target <= $0.31 | Current: -- | P0 > $0.50 24h trend | P1 > $0.40 24h trend | Owner: Finance (Sophie) | P0: throttle non-critical calls + enable quantized variant; P1: apply caching TTL extension for repeated prompts
- KV cache hit rate (inference cache): Target >= 65% | Current: -- | P0 < 30% 30min | P1 < 50% 1h | Owner: Runtime (Devon) | P0: rebuild cache prefixes + warm with synthetic runs; P1: increase cache memory pool for hotspot routes
- SLA breach count (customer-impacting): Target 0 | Current: -- | P0 >= 1 critical customer impacted | P1 >= 3 minor customers | Owner: CS Lead (Sophie) | P0: customer-level mitigation call + credit offer; P1: prioritize support routing

CONTINGENCY MATRIX:
- P0 (system-critical): immediate ops channel, page SRE+Infra+Product Ops, start emergency runbook. Steps: 1) Stop progressive rollout (if any). 2) Route new traffic to warm dedicated pool or alternative region. 3) Enable fallback model variant (quantized or smaller). 4) Notify affected customers and CS. 5) Hold new deploys until root cause triaged.
- P1 (severe but contained): convene 15-minute triage, adjust capacity/batching, slow the ramp of traffic, enable cost-saving measures only after stability restored.
- P2 (degradation within tolerance): monitor, throttle nonessential background jobs, schedule follow-up postmortem action items.

RUNWAY / CAPACITY PLAYGROUND (scenarios and reservations):
- Scenario A: 2x expected peak for 2 hours — reserve +20% dedicated GPUs and pre-warm KVs for top 10 routes.
- Scenario B: sustained 3x for 30 minutes — enable burst reserved capacity (contracted) + enable fast-fallback fraction (20% traffic to cheaper model).
- Scenario C: region outage — shift 60% traffic to secondary region, reduce batch window to keep latency tight.

PRELAUNCH CHECKLIST (quick gate):
- Golden prompt pass-rate: 95%+ on critical eval set (Aisha)
- E2E smoke tests (staging>prod): success across top-50 routes (Devon)
- Observability hooks: per-route token counts, p95 latency, cost per route enabled (Rahul)
- Circuit breakers set: per-customer QPS caps deployed (Sophie)
- Rollout policy: slow-roll with automated rollback on P1/P0 triggers (Product Ops)
- Communications: incident channel created, CS pre-briefed, status page stub ready

OWNER RACI (short):
- Product Ops (Aisha): Runbook authoring, final go/no-go decision, communications
- SRE/Infra (Rahul, Devon): Capacity activation, autoscale tuning, fallbacks
- Customer Success (Sophie): Customer comms, SLA tracking, credits
- Finance: monitor cost drift and approve emergency spend

ESCALATION PATH:
- 0-5min: page oncall SRE + infra lead.
- 5-20min: add product ops + CS lead, start mitigation actions.
- 20-60min: Exec brief + legal/compliance if customer data impacted.

CHANGE LOG (placeholder rows — fill after launch):
- 2025-11-03: Created by Aisha Patel — initial template and metric list.
- 2025-11-12: Added capacity scenarios and P0 actions (Devon).

NOTES / EXPERIMENTS TO RUN DURING PREWARM:
- Warm-up script: replay top-1k prefixes at 10% of expected QPS to populate KV cache.
- Batch tuning runbook: run synthetic traffic with varying batch windows (10ms, 25ms, 50ms) and measure p95 vs cost.
- Quantized fallback experiment: compare output quality regression on golden prompt set before enabling at-scale.

ATTACHMENTS (links to artifacts): CONFLUENCE-4567 (Launch runbook), JIRA-OPS-2219 (preflight tickets), github.com/redwood-inference/ops-playbooks/pull/87 (playbook updates).

ENDPOINT: keep this sheet live during the first 72h and archive with outcomes in Confluence after the window.
